title: Freeze the cross-machine candidate and complete kernel coverage
requires: Any development host; access to current API, schedule and qualification records
scope: Freeze a single integrated source/profile/kernel/workload/tolerance/budget tuple and prepare the exhaustive device qualification matrix before parallel hardware testing. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Compile shared kernels/reflection/bindings for CUDA, Vulkan, D3D12 and Metal and validate that every manifest entry/variant has an applicable runtime test; compile-only results are not qualification.
Record exact source revision, artifacts/toolchains, profile version and manifest hashes; enumerate all physical registered devices and missing availability explicitly.
Create extra bounded device qualification/fix tasks where needed and add them to the exit dependencies before claiming F8-99; keep active task definitions frozen.
Document candidate invalidation: later kernel/schedule/physics/profile changes require a new candidate and affected-device reruns, never a union of incompatible green reports.
evidence: CMake 4.1.2 Release CUDA build: PASS 615/615 edges

history.reason: Froze one hash-bound realtime candidate, proved complete kernel/runtime-case mapping, compiled CUDA/Vulkan/D3D12/Metal artifacts, enumerated all physical targets, and defined strict invalidation.
